label: Quality (profitability, growth, safety)
blurb: Three pillars: profitability (gross profits, ROE, ROA, cash flow over assets, gross margin, low accruals), growth (their five-year change) and safety (low beta, low leverage, low O-score, high Z-score, stable earnings), each a z-score of ranks, summed and standardised.
literature: Asness, Frazzini & Pedersen (2019), Review of Accounting Studies
